flip_era: No care-side flip detected: GF-basis care/cage ratio is flat-to-down across the Cortex/NGA-revival era (FY13 0.133 → FY19 0.118) vs pre-Cortex FY00 0.164. The only visible "step" appears as era-level funding shifts OUTSIDE the ratio: (a) FY10-12 cage surge (police+polret+jails ~210-219M GF), (b) FY15 care bump from one-off CDA/AHC print, (c) FY17-19 GF-ratio floor at ~0.118 as cage drifted up and care stagnated in nominal GF terms — care did NOT rise with the revival; revival-era care money appears in special funds (Prop P parks, 2017+) rather than the GF care ratio.
ledger_class: Cortex/NGA revival is LEDGER-INVISIBLE in the city operating budget: Cortex (founded 2002, 501(c)(3), $29M founder land collateral, Chapter 353 master-developer tax abatements + TIF in the private/nonprofit lane) and NGA-North ($1.7B federal construction, opened Sep 2025; city role = site subsidy/land assembly via McKee-era northside, not operating-budget lines) both sit OUTSIDE the GF care/cage ledger. City TIF trustee lines are tiny and stable in all sampled books (FY02 1.89M / FY12 1.39M / FY14 0.62M / FY18 1.28M special-funds) — consistent with the CIN/OTR private-capital class candidate, i.e., the revival printed abatements/TIF/eminent-domain authority, not care-ratio movement.
confidence: medium-high on GF figures (all page-cited from adopted AOP PDFs); medium on cross-era comparability (department restructurings: corrections folded, police local control 2015, Prop P special funds 2017+, FY27 all-funds basis)
falsifier: A GF-only FY27 extraction showing care/cage >= 0.30 would falsify "no flip"; alternatively an all-funds series recomputation across all sampled years (including Prop P + special-fund parks/health money) showing a monotonic care-side climb from FY15 onward would falsify the ledger-invisible verdict. Both are one PDF-column pass away from the same archive.
